title: Syrian-Style Pilaf Cakes
description: A twist on traditional pilaf, these warm and gooey Syrian-style pilaf cakes are perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and pilaf.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Heat the skillet or griddle and cook the cakes for 2-3 minutes on each side.
